calculator.details_3_cycles: Insufficient sleep. You will likely experience daytime drowsiness.
calculator.details_4_cycles: Minimum sleep. Sufficient to function, but you might feel accumulated fatigue.
calculator.details_5_cycles: Ideal sleep. Meets general recommendation for healthy rest.
calculator.details_6_cycles: Optimal sleep. You will wake up feeling refreshed with maximum mental alertness.
calculator.nap_20_desc: Light NREM stage. Clears brain adenosine without entering deep sleep to avoid grogginess.
calculator.nap_26_desc: NASA scientific study: improves performance by +34% and mental alertness by +54%.
calculator.nap_90_desc: 1 full cycle with REM sleep. Consolidates memory & creativity when waking at the end of the cycle.

settings.faq_cycles_a: Your brain goes through 4 sleep stages every ~90 minutes. Waking up at the end of a cycle feels natural and refreshed.
settings.faq_hygiene_a: Avoid blue light screens 1 hour before bed, keep bedroom cool (~18°C / 65°F), and stop caffeine 6 hours before sleep.
settings.faq_inertia_a: Waking up during deep slow-wave sleep causes 'sleep inertia': disorientation, headaches, and grogginess.
settings.faq_nasa_a: NASA studies on pilots showed 26 min optimizes alertness (+54%) and performance (+34%) right before entering deep sleep.
settings.faq_nasa_q: Why is the NASA Nap 26 minutes?
